sub_graphs.title: SSZ: Single-Item Merkle Proof Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime process of generating and verifying a single-item Merkle proof against a known root

nodes.label: Proof Verification Request Received
nodes.description: System receives a leaf value, generalized index, proof (sibling hashes), and expected root for verification

nodes.label: Check Proof Length Matches Index Depth
nodes.description: Verify len(proof) == get_generalized_index_length(index), ensuring proof has correct number of sibling hashes for the tree depth

nodes.label: Reconstruct Merkle Root from Leaf
nodes.description: Iteratively hash leaf with proof siblings, choosing left/right position based on generalized index bit at each level

nodes.label: Compare Reconstructed Root with Expected
nodes.description: Check if the reconstructed root equals the expected root to determine proof validity

nodes.label: Proof Valid
nodes.description: Reconstructed root matches expected root; the leaf is authenticated as part of the tree

nodes.label: Proof Invalid
nodes.description: Roots do not match; the leaf or proof data is incorrect or tampered

edges.label: External entity provides proof data for verification

external_entities.name: Proof Provider
external_entities.description: External entity (e.g., light client server, P2P peer) providing a Merkle proof for verification

sub_graphs.title: SSZ: Multi-Item Merkle Proof Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime process of verifying multiple leaves simultaneously against a single root using a compact multi-proof

nodes.label: Multi-Proof Verification Request Received
nodes.description: System receives multiple leaves with their generalized indices, helper proof nodes, and expected root

nodes.label: Compute Helper Indices
nodes.description: Calculate the minimal set of auxiliary node indices needed to reconstruct the root from the given leaf indices using get_helper_indices

nodes.label: Check Multi-Proof Length
nodes.description: Verify len(proof) == len(helper_indices), ensuring the correct number of auxiliary nodes are provided

nodes.label: Reconstruct Root from Multiple Leaves
nodes.description: Combine leaves and helper nodes into an object map, iterate sorted indices descending, compute parent nodes when both children known, until root (index 1) is computed

nodes.label: Compare Multi-Proof Root
nodes.description: Check reconstructed root at generalized index 1 against expected root

nodes.label: Multi-Proof Valid
nodes.description: All leaves authenticated as belonging to the same tree

nodes.label: Multi-Proof Invalid
nodes.description: Root mismatch; one or more leaves or proof nodes are incorrect

external_entities.name: Multi-Proof Provider
external_entities.description: External entity providing a compact multi-proof for simultaneous verification of multiple tree leaves

sub_graphs.title: SSZ: Generalized Index Path Resolution
sub_graphs.description: Models the process of converting human-readable object paths into generalized indices for tree navigation

nodes.label: Object Path Received
nodes.description: A path describing nested object access is received, e.g., ['y', 5, 'w']

nodes.label: Resolve SSZ Type at Current Level
nodes.description: Determine the SSZ type (container, vector, list, basic) at the current path element to calculate the correct child index

nodes.label: Compute Child Generalized Index
nodes.description: For containers: field position determines index. For lists/vectors: element position with chunk packing. Length accessed via __len__ path

nodes.label: Concatenate Generalized Indices
nodes.description: Combine parent and child generalized indices via concat_generalized_indices to produce the final tree position

nodes.label: Generalized Index Resolved
nodes.description: The final generalized index for the path is computed, ready for proof generation or verification

edges.label: Begin type resolution for first path element

external_entities.name: Proof System Caller
external_entities.description: Internal component requesting generalized index computation for proof generation or verification

ambiguities.text: The specification states that basic elements are 'packed into single 32-byte chunks' but does not explicitly define behavior when a basic element's serialized size does not evenly divide 32 bytes.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard SSZ chunk packing rules: elements are packed left-to-right with zero-padding to fill the final 32-byte chunk.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define error behavior when a generalized index is out of bounds for the given SSZ type schema.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume out-of-bounds generalized indices result in a runtime error that rejects the proof as invalid.

implicit_assumptions.description: The expected root used for verification is assumed to come from a trusted source (e.g., a finalized beacon state root).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the expected root is compromised, any proof can be made to appear valid or invalid, completely undermining the authentication mechanism.

implicit_assumptions.description: It is assumed that an attacker cannot find SHA-256 collisions to forge valid proofs for incorrect leaf values.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Hash collision capability would allow forging Merkle proofs for arbitrary data, breaking the integrity of all SSZ-based state verification.
